{vkd3d-proton-app-db v1}
# The first line serves as magic that must be preserved verbatim.
# The bitflags may change meaning as vkd3d-proton is updated.
# Each game gets one line.
# Is a comment.
# Format is loosely inspired by SDL gamepad database to aid parsing in plain C without dependencies.
# This format can easily be autogenerated by other tools before being consumed by vkd3d-proton.
# Every column is comma separated
# Columns. Columns can be dropped if they're not relevant.
# steam appid - (can be 0 if not a Steam game, or unknown)
# .exe name - can be encoded with the exe name as-is for full match. "<name" for starts with, ">name" ends with, "?name" contains, "=name" full match (to disambiguate), and "@hash" where hash is the hash reported in vkd3d-proton log.
# Engine detection - Valid values: anything else (generic), UnrealEngine, or REEngine
# major, minor, patch optionally follows.
# Examples:
1234,=blah.exe,UnrealEngine,4,2
1235,<blah.exe,UnrealEngine,6,2,3
1236,>-Win64-Shipping.exe,UnrealEngine,5
1237,@abcdefg,REEngine,2,3
